events.title: TOP STEED Next Fest demo is out!
events.summary: The TOP STEED Next Fest demo is fresh out of the oven! Race solo or online across two tracks, Tokyo Shift and Kings Field, and hit the tutorial arena for some practice laps.Please take a moment to fill out our feedback form (also linked in the demo’s main menu). And if you’re enjoying the game, a wishlist genuinely helps us out.Now slip into your fastest riding boots and show everyone who’s got the TOP STEED!

events.title: That's a wrap on Playtest 2!
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who rode with us. Next up: a public demo at Steam Next Fest, 19 to 26 October. Wishlist now so you get the ping when it goes live.

events.title: PLAYTEST 2 extended through the weekend
events.summary: We're extending TOP STEED's multiplayer playtest through the weekend! The new end date is Monday, September 14 at 10:00 AM PT / 7:00 PM CEST.We greatly appreciate your feedback - and remember to wishlist!

events.title: PLAYTEST 2 - Online Multiplayer
events.summary: First of all, a huge thank you to all who participated in TOP STEED's Playtest 1 and sent us feedback! It's invaluable in helping us shape the game.Playtest 1 closes on September 4 at 10:00 AM PT / 7:00 PM CEST, and Playtest 2 opens right after, running a full week through September 11.Playtest 2 is all about online multiplayer, and a new track, Kings Field, has been added! events.title: Playtest 1 is live!
events.summary: Welcome to the first-ever playtest of TOP STEED! To get started, hit the Request Access button on the store page if you haven't already. The playtest ends September 7 at 10:00 AM PT / 7:00 PM CEST.After playing, please take a moment to fill out the feedback form (also linked in the main menu). And if you're enjoying the game, wishlist TOP STEED — it means a lot to us.Now take the reins and race your way to the podium!

events.title: Sign up for the first Playtest!
events.summary: Get Ready to Saddle Up!On Friday, August 28, we're handing you the reins for the first time. In this single-player playtest you'll be racing bots around the Tokyo downtown track. A tutorial track will also be available. The second playtest will focus on online multiplayer, so stay tuned for that as well!The main menu will include a link to a short feedback form. events.title: TOP STEED joins Steam Horse Fest
events.summary: We’re excited to join Steam Horse Fest with TOP STEED! Saddle up, virtually, and load in to a once-in-a-lifetime racing experience! TOP STEED combines the best elements of high-speed car racing with the excitement of a steeplechase as you gallop through the holographic track, clearing obstacles (or crashing through scenery).Riders will feel right at home with the realistic controls, using both legs and reins to guide their horse, while the arcade controls offer a more classic feel.
